items.title: What Is Micron Technology (MU) Up Against In The New AI Stock Race?
items.summary: Micron Technology (NasdaqGS:MU) sits at the center of a shift in AI market leadership as investors increasingly compare chipmakers with cloud hyperscalers like Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft. Recent commentary in 2026 highlights that cloud hyperscalers are now converting large AI infrastructure budgets into clearer long term profit plans. This change in focus is prompting investors to reassess which companies might lead the next phase of AI spending and returns. The new narrative suggests...

items.title: Infiltrated: North Korea's Secret U.S. Workforce
items.summary: North Korean operatives are using stolen identities, AI and American accomplices to land jobs at U.S. companies, funneling millions back to the regime. WSJ’s yearlong investigation reveals how one team infiltrated eight companies in just a few months.
